items.title: Intel’s Skid Continues: One of The Biggest Global Banks Says It Will Provide 130% Returns From Here
items.summary: HSBC just blew up the consensus on Intel with a price target that towers above every other analyst on the Street, and it landed right as the stock shed 15% in a single week. Whether that call is visionary or reckless depends on a foundry business that has never turned a profit.

items.title: 2 S&P 500 Stocks to Research Further and 1 We Ignore
items.summary: While the S&P 500 (^GSPC) includes industry leaders, not every stock in the index is a winner. Some companies are past their prime, weighed down by poor execution, weak financials, or structural headwinds.

items.title: Prediction: TSMC Stock Will Soar After Aug. 26 Thanks to Nvidia’s Historic Quarter
items.summary: Nvidia's upcoming earnings report is likely to give TSMC stock a nice shot in the arm.

items.title: What You Actually Pay To Join The MU Run
items.summary: A powerful run in this AI-critical stock has paused, forcing investors to decide if its world-class business engine has more fuel than the market has priced in.

items.title: After Its Recent Stumble, Is Broadcom Stock An Opportunity Or A Trap?
items.summary: The chipmaker's AI business is booming, but the stock just hit a rough patch, forcing investors to weigh a powerful history against a pricey present.

items.title: Marvell Technology Stock More Than Tripled On A Roadmap It Had Been Publishing All Along
items.summary: The clues to the run sat in dated interconnect milestones, not in the custom-silicon question that dominated the argument surrounding the stock.

items.title: NVIDIA Stock Can Fall By A Third Or Rise By Half And Still Be Normal
items.summary: The band the options market has drawn around this stock is barely wider than the swings it already delivers, which makes that width a baseline rather than a passing scare.

items.title: The AI Opportunity Qualcomm Investors May Be Underestimating
items.summary: Wall Street treats Qualcomm like a handset company in slow decline, but a closer look at its data center roadmap and two confirmed hyperscaler wins suggests investors are pricing in the wrong business entirely.
